item.title: Small Business Owners Have More AI Insight Than Ever — But It’s Stuck in Dashboards. Here’s How to Put It to Work.
item.description: Small business owners today have access to a significant volume of data when it comes to managing their business, and their employee data may reveal insights that are hiding in plain sight. Most business leaders have access to workforce dashboards to track turnover, overtime, engagement, cost per hire in real time, and more. What they truly need is the ability to turn that data into a decision before the moment that matters has passed.
